prompt: Our client wants an HR management platform for mid-size companies (50-500 employees). Core features: employee directory, leave management, payroll integration (with local Vietnamese payroll providers), performance reviews, org chart. They want a web app + mobile app. The team is 3 devs + 1 designer. Can you scope this with estimates? We need to know timeline and effort.

assertions.name: produces-pdf
assertions.description: A PDF file exists in the outputs directory

assertions.name: covers-all-sdlc-stages
assertions.description: WBS covers all 6 SDLC stages: Discovery, Design, Development, QA, Deployment, Maintenance

assertions.name: module-level-granularity
assertions.description: Items are at module level (e.g. Leave Management Module) not task level

assertions.name: evaluates-multiple-approaches
assertions.description: At least 2 distinct technical approaches are analyzed with tradeoffs

assertions.name: technical-feasibility-present
assertions.description: Feasibility assessment exists for major requirements

assertions.name: brand-compliant-no-red
assertions.description: PDF uses ZenLabs brand colors and does not use red for risk/error indicators

assertions.name: includes-man-day-estimates
assertions.description: Each module has effort estimates in man-days

assertions.name: shows-total-timeline
assertions.description: A total project timeline or critical path is included
